sample_command: pixelmon 'front view of an iron portcullis gate in a dark grey castle stone archway, black passage behind, the gate fills the frame' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)' --out 64x96 --palette none --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --no-sprite-suffix --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 4113
